preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of officers is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Chef's initial coordinate is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The initial coordinates of the officers are between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: P_i != C for all 1 <= i <= N
preconditions.description: Chef's initial coordinate is different from all officers' initial coordinates.

preconditions.expression: P_i != P_j for all 1 <= i < j <= N
preconditions.description: No two officers have the same initial coordinate.

postconditions.expression: output[i][0] is the maximum number of officers that can be eliminated by Chef in test case i, and output[i][1] is 1 if Chef runs away or -1 if Chef will be caught.
postconditions.description: The output for each test case contains two integers: the first is the maximum number of officers that can be eliminated, and the second is the result of Chef running away or being caught.
